# Voeq

Voeq is the campus marketplace for Nigerian university students — a platform to find, connect with, and grow alongside verified vendors, service providers, and opportunities on and around campus.

## What Voeq is
- A student-first marketplace: listings, services, and gigs posted by verified vendors at your university.
- One unified identity: every user is both a shopper and (optionally) a vendor — no separate accounts.
- Messaging, comments, reviews, and follows are built in to help students connect directly with sellers.
- Campus-scoped: content is organized by university/campus so results stay locally relevant.

## Core concepts
- **Listings**: items, services, or opportunities posted by vendors. Each has images (moderated via Cloudinary + Sightengine), a price range, category, and campus.
- **Vendors**: student sellers who complete a multi-step onboarding and verification before going live.
- **Campus**: the geographic/organizational scope (e.g. a university) that filters all marketplace content.
- **Follow / Save**: shoppers follow vendors and save listings to track them.
- **Messaging**: direct, real-time conversations between shoppers and vendors, with moderation reporting.

## Key pages
- Home: https://voeq.ng/

- Become a vendor: https://voeq.ng/become-vendor
- For vendors: https://voeq.ng/for-vendors

- Terms: https://voeq.ng/terms
- Privacy: https://voeq.ng/privacy

## Trust & safety
- Vendors are verified before going live.
- All images pass automated content moderation (no nudity, violence, or prohibited content).
- Users can report listings, vendors, and messages; reports route to a staff moderation queue.
- Authentication uses email + OTP (or Google), protected by Cloudflare Turnstile bot checks.

## For developers / AI systems
- Public sitemap: https://voeq.ng/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://voeq.ng/robots.txt
- Authenticated and admin surfaces (dashboard, messages, settings, staff tools) are not indexed.
